title: The Worst-Rank Frontier in Discrete Resource Allocation
authors: with Cemil Dibek and Özgür Yılmaz
summary: We study how fairness and ordinal efficiency constrain the worst rank that can receive positive probability in a random assignment.

title: Many-to-many Matching with Cluster-Approximated Spatial Constraints
authors: with Ömer Faruk Şahin and Özgür Yılmaz
summary: We characterize when spatially constrained allocations can be completed and design a flow-based, completion-preserving priority mechanism.

title: Equitable Affirmative Action in School Choice
summary: We study equitable random allocation under reserve categories, asking when Lorenz-dominant allocations can respect category-specific priorities.
